title: THE DEMO BOARD HAS TWENTY ROWS
why: His answers 12 and 13: the DEMO high score board has twenty rows, and it resets only through NEW PARTY in the operator menu. It listed the top ten runs of the last twelve hours, so a long party quietly lost its early scores off the board. Now it lists the top twenty of every run since the last NEW PARTY (or every run, when there has not been one), however old, and the attract page draws them in two columns of ten. NEW PARTY clears it, BEST EVER is unchanged, and the seeded night from NEW PARTY now lasts until the next NEW PARTY too, so the board stays fair for as long as it stays. The initials card is offered to any run that makes the twenty.
now: The DEMO high score board holds twenty rows and is cleared only by NEW PARTY in the operator menu.
